connect_yuanbao_adapter: connect a YuanbaoAdapter to the Yuanbao WebSocket gateway with sign-token authentication and heartbeat
chunk_markdown_text: use MarkdownProcessor.chunk_markdown_text to split Markdown into chunks without breaking code fences or tables
get_sign_token: use SignManager.get_token to fetch and cache a Yuanbao WS auth token with automatic refresh
build_inbound_pipeline: use InboundPipelineBuilder.build to create a middleware pipeline for processing inbound Yuanbao messages
send_text_message: use MessageSender.send_text to send auto-chunked text messages to a Yuanbao chat with per-chat locking
